tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// sbyin sreg gi sdom tshig bzhugs// ༄༅// na maḥshrī tsakra samba rā ya/ nyon mongs bud shing kun bsregs shing*// ye shes lnga yi 'od rab 'bar// 'gro ba'i mun nag rnam sel ba'i// rdo rje me la phyag 'tshal nas// srid pa'i rlan las rnam skyes pa'i// nyes tshogs tshang tshing bsreg bya'i phyir// spyod pa'i rdo rje'i rjes 'brangs nas// sbyin sreg cho ga bdag gis bshad// zhi ba shar du zlum po dkar// bud shing 'o ma can gyi rtse// me ni bram ze'i rgyun zhag shis// rgyas pa lho ru gru bzhi ser// 'bras bu can gyi rked pa'i cha// rgyal rigs khyim nas byung ba'i me// dbang la nub na gru gsum dmar// me tog dmar po ldan pa'i shing*// smad 'tshong ma yi khyim gyi me// drag po byang du zla gam nag /tsher ma can gyi rtsa ba'i cha// gdol ba'i khyim nas byung ba'i me// thab khung rgyar ni khru gang sogs// zabs su de yi phyed yin te// sor bzhi la sogs bskyed byas nas// de yi tshad kyi mu ran brtsigs// las kyi kha khyer de yi phyed// sor bzhi'i rgya la de phyed 'phang*// nang gi kha khyer mu ran la// padma gri gug phreng ba bri// las kyi kha khyer las bzhi yi// rdo rje rin chen padma dmar// rdo rje rtse gsum phreng ba bri// thab dbus padma 'dab brgyad la// lte bar rdo rje gri gug dang*// phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi mtshams bzhir snod// phyi rol 'khor lo rim pa gsum// gzhal yas khang bcas phyogs mtshams su// lcags kyu sogs bzhi gri gug bzhi// phyi rol dur khrod de yi mthar// mu khyud la gnas shar phyogs su// padma dbyu gu phreng ba dang*// spyi blugs ri dwags bags pa'o// lhor ni rtse gsum zla tshes dang*// rgyal mtshan ral pa'i thor tshugs mig /nub tu 'khor lo dung dang ni// dbyug tho ral gri phub rnams so// byang du mdung dang dril bu dang*// ba dan rma bya ra skyes bri// phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng ba la// mtshams bzhir rdo rje phyed pa'o// chas gos 'dug stangs bsam pa dang*// lha yi rten dang nyams dang mdangs// gsang sngags kyi ni spel tshig sogs// las dang rjes su mthun par bya// mda' dgu tshon skud me long bzhi// phur bu bcu dang ku sha dang*// rdor dril dgang blugs nang mchod dang*// bum pa lnga dang mchod yon gnyis// bsreg rdzas yam shing mar dang til// bcu pa zho dang ku sha dang*// dūr ba nas gro so ba 'bras// sran ma dang ni 'bras bu rnams// khyad par du ni zhi la til// rgyas la zho dang dbang me tog

/drag po la ni sha rnams te// mchog gi don du bcu pa dbul// mchod rdzas rnam bdun gtor ma gsum// 'jam po gsum la bsreg rdzas g.yas// drag po de las bzlog par bsham// phyag gnyis pa yi nga rgyal gyis// sngags bcas pho nya bcu spro zhing*// stang stabs sbyor bas bgegs bskrad nas// srung 'khor bsgom zhing phur bus gdab// bum bzlas mchod yon byin gyis brlabs// thab dang yo byad bsang zhing sbyang*// bskyed nas byin gyis brlab par bya// me btsal me lha bskyed byas nas// spyan drangs byon zan dbul zhing mchod// bstim nas dbang bskur rigs rgyas gdab// ku sha mda' skud me long dgram// me lha mchod nas bsreg rdzas dbul// bstod nas 'bar bar gyur pa'i dbus// yan lag bzhi rdzogs cho ga yis// dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas gsang sngags dang*// phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod// rdzas rnams so so'i sngags kyis ni// spyi'am lha yi grangs kyis sam// lnga la rnam lnga gzhan la gcig /re re'i mthar yang mchod bstod bya// gtor mas mchod nas dngos grub bslang*// gshegs su gsol nas sngon bzhin du// me lha mchod nas de nyid dang*// phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma dbul// bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol// smon lam gdab cing bdag nyid bsrung*// las kyi rjes bsdu thal ba rnams// rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor// tshul 'di he ru ka dpal gyi// sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*// thun mong pa dang khyad par gyi// dngos grub thob byed mchog tu gsungs// me 'brug rgyal gyi zla ba yi// yar gyi ngo yi tshes bcu la// hu chu zhes bya'i grong khyer du// legs par bris pa 'di rdzogs so// rgyal ba'i gsung rab gces pa'i mdzod 'dzin yang dag grub brnyes bla ma brgyud pa las 'ongs pa'i// dngos grub 'gugs byed las kyi mchog rab sbyin sreg cho ga'i rnam gzhag rim pa rab gsal ba// chos kyi rgyal po bzang po'i zhabs kyi zhabs rdul gus len 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pa yis// legs par bsdebs las bsod nams me 'od rab tu 'bar bas sdug bsngal bud shing bsreg par shog
/slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg lag tu blang ba'i sdom nyi shu bdun pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
